payload.text: LINUX AND BREW (hv, 2026-10-14): devbin and Intent work properly on Ubuntu, proven on kovacs, and install with brew on Linux and macOS (hv: "I want BOTH devbin and intent work from 'brew install' and for them to BOTH work seamlessly on Unix (the kovacs VM in this case)"). Restated by hv through another estate's session the same morning: through Homebrew on macOS and Linux, with nothing installed from a local repository, so the brew install becomes the machine install that projects vendor from; that estate waits on the first release that carries Linux binaries. Planned by devbin-vc and intent-vc with hv. kovacs-sysadm, a Remote Control session on kovacs, does the VM side on orders from either vc; there is one queue for kovacs, intent-vc's, with one order per step, each copied to the other vc. kovacs, read 2026-10-14: Ubuntu 26.04.1 on aarch64, 2 CPUs, 3.3 GiB, uutils coreutils 0.10.0, GNU parallel 20240222; GitHub auth works as hv; hv's home is readable there at ~/mac, so a bundle goes in vc's scratch. Order: provisioning; Intent's bin/int linux build, package and smoke from a bundle of its main; Intent's AT-05.1; a user-level drive of Intent; devbin's Linux proof with Intent's package on PATH (main's HEAD by bundle, test all read from its seal, check all with the critic gate); brew last, as hv rules. devbin has no formula or tap yet (0195 builds the formula) and its repo is private; Intent's formula is macOS arm64 only by hv's ruling of 2026-08-15, and Intent's ST0081, renumbered on 2026-10-14, is now its Homebrew thread for Linux and macOS (doing 81). STATE after the compact of 2026-10-14: ORDER 1 (provisioning) is COMPLETE, as kovacs-sysadm reported. apt gave libxml2-utils, musl-tools, build-essential, xz-utils, curl and procps; the four download steps that kovacs-sysadm's permission classifier refused, hv ran by hand in ~/prov/provision-rest.sh, every one at rc 0: bats 1.12.0 at /usr/local/bin, first on PATH (CI's pin; apt's 1.13.0 is shadowed), shellcheck 0.11.0 at /usr/local/bin, Rust 1.99.0 with the aarch64 gnu and musl targets, and Homebrew 7.0.9 at /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew, off PATH. Caveat: hv's zshrc puts ~/.cargo/bin on PATH in interactive zsh, hv's ! commands included. ORDER 2 (Intent's clone and doctor) found Intent's own silent exit 127 without rustc (Intent's issue 0595); devbin's dispatcher ran clean under uutils and mawk. devbin's ORDER D1 (the suite at main 2ff34a98, which carries 0193's code, with TMPDIR on disk since kovacs's /tmp is a 1.7 GB tmpfs) was refused by the same classifier and waits for hv to run it; with CI's bats and shellcheck in place it is the full proof, not an early reading. vc reads its seal over ssh, read-only, and tells intent-vc its start and end. No vc routes around that boundary, ssh included. The queue after D1: Intent's build, AT-05.1, Intent's user drive, devbin's check all with Intent's package, Intent's shell suite under uutils and mawk, then the brew rehearsal for both.
